description: Update the 4StoreyBuilding eQUEST model to use high-performance fenestration. Locate ALL 'GLASS-TYPE' definitions in the Building Shell and update them to: GLASS-CONDUCTANCE = 0.29 and SHADING-COEF = 0.40. If a glass type references a library code, change it to define properties explicitly. After updating all glass types, run the full annual simulation and save the project.
